name: Analyse urbaine générale
description: Vue d'ensemble urbaine : bâtiments, routes, espaces verts, hydrographie. Style par catégorie avec mise en page cartographique.

steps.description: Styliser les bâtiments (gris foncé, contour fin)
steps.code:
from qgis.core import QgsFillSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
bat = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'atiment' in l.name()]
if bat:
    sym = QgsFillSymbol.createSimple({'color': '180,180,180,200', 'outline_color': '100,100,100', 'outline_width': '0.2'})
    bat[0].setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
    bat[0].triggerRepaint()
    result['styled'] = 'buildings'
result['success'] = True

from qgis.core import QgsLineSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
routes = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'oute' in l.name() or 'Route' in l.name()]
if routes:
    sym = QgsLineSymbol.createSimple({'color': '80,80,80', 'width': '0.4'})
    routes[0].setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
    routes[0].triggerRepaint()
    result['styled'] = 'roads'
result['success'] = True

from qgis.core import QgsFillSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
veg = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'égétation' in l.name() or 'egetation' in l.name()]
if veg:
    sym = QgsFillSymbol.createSimple({'color': '100,180,80,140', 'outline_color': '60,120,40', 'outline_width': '0.2'})
    veg[0].setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
    veg[0].triggerRepaint()
    result['styled'] = 'vegetation'
result['success'] = True

from qgis.core import QgsLineSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
hydro = [l for l in project.mapLayers().values() if 'eau' in l.name() or 'hydro' in l.name().lower()]
if hydro:
    sym = QgsLineSymbol.createSimple({'color': '65,105,225', 'width': '0.8'})
    hydro[0].setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
    hydro[0].triggerRepaint()
    result['styled'] = 'hydro'
result['success'] = True
